title: Tesserone user export file
description: Shareable backup / single-card share-out. Produced by the Expo app as version 2.1.0. cards is an array (not a map). customLogoUri is inlined as a data URI in 2.1.0+; older files may store a bare filename or a file:// URI.

settings.description: Partial settings. Expo 2.1.0 writes themeMode and sortMode; language may be absent. All fields optional.

exportedAt.description: ISO-8601 timestamp of when the file was written.

version.description: Export format version string (not the native schemaVersion integer). Current producer writes 2.1.0.

BarcodeFormat.description: Canonical export uses uppercase. Importers must also accept the lowercase/legacy aliases in README (ean13 → EAN13, itf → ITF14, unknown → CODE128).

customLogoUri.description: 2.1.0+ inlines the logo as a data URI (data:image/…;base64,…). Older exports may use a bare filename or a file:// URI; the importer keeps only the filename portion (or materializes a data URI to a new file).
